plugins.name: reflect-cycle
plugins.description: Reflect record state machine: idle -> reflecting -> done. Wakes after a subject's work has landed and verify and/or review have concluded (a verify-record reaching `cleared`, or a review-record reaching `reported`); the reflect-record must carry a non-empty pointer to the other role records it read; its findings are advisory only per contract §5.

plugins.name: reflect-agent-env
plugins.description: One-install environment bundle: installs reflect-cycle via dependency.
